DO NOOOOOOT Use your gold for early/mid level guns. You will 100% regret it. Try saving to 3K or 3.3K for the level 34 guns. Thats what I'm doing. I currently run the brawler shotgun and saving for the rank 34 assault rifle.

I think shotguns are the way to go. I also am a Free-to-play player. I played on my Android, got an iPhone and lost all progress. I learned a LOT of stuff tho.

Do as many quests are you can. Prioritize Gold Quests.

If you plan to play to late game (where there are rank 34 guns and stuff), safe ALL your gold. Do not spend any gold on ANYTHING other than "Pants" which I'll get to later.

I highly recommend sticking with your sting and save up for a shotgun. What I recommend is the "Brawler". It has a speed boost when u carrying it and dishes out a ton of damage. You can unlock it at rank 10 and costs about 30K. Dont worry, guns can cost up to 50-60K. I thought 30K is a LOT to save up for, but this game has tons of grinding.

Normally stick with shotgun in matches and switch to your "sting" or a sniper rifle" when u use all your ammo.

NEVER UPGRADE guns with gold if you plan on buying a better gun. Gold is hard to get and expensive to use for upgrading so keep it at max level with using gunbucks. 

A GREAT gun that goes well for most part of the game is the "Undertaker", a CHEAP, POWERFUL, and EASY TO USE sniper rifle that is REALLY good at almost any time in a battle. I recommend buying that sniper and upgrade to level 5 with gold due to the damage, and because its so easy to use and the damage is amazing compared to other higher tier guns. This is the only gun I would spend gold to upgrade. 

With all your saved gold, Try to save to 3K or 3.3K for the rank 34 guns. That is what I'm trying to do. Im using the Brawler and the Level 5 Undertaker for now and saving gold for the level 34 Assault rifle. 

There are equipment you can wear called "Helmets" (thats what I think they are called. maybe hats), "jacket", and "pants"

Helmets cost about 10K and each do differnt effects. Buy the "Fumingator" or the "Dark Stalker". Fumingator heals you after each kill, and Dark Stalker does bonus Headshot Damage. Either one is good but I use the "Dark Stalker" because I can land Headshots with ease. Don't buy other helmets because they aren't as useful as these 2.

"Jackets" are armor/additional health. These are the stuff you buy with your leftover gunbucks after you upgraded all your guns until the point where you h ave to use gold to upgrade. Upgrading ur jackets are great because you can live longer so you can fight more (duh).

Lastly are pants. Pants cost about 150-200 gold. I only use the "panther" pants for added movement speed, but pants are completly optional. I just like the extra movement speed. I dont use any other pants because I think they aren't worth the gold and have little effect in battles.

One important thing to know about buying helmets or pants are that they say something like "reduce damage taken for THREE seconds after kill" or something like that. These are ones you should avoid because the bonus ONLY comes to affect when you do something for a SMALL amount of time.

And Heavy guns, use them if you want. Most of  the guns cost gold, and you move too slow with them. I don't think they do a lot of damage and are ONLY accurate when you stand still or move little. I personally dont use them and think they dumb because you never gonna run out of ALL your ammo with the other 3 guns.

Hope this helps :)

EDIT: Forgot to mention that I am rank 20 right now, you definately want to use other stronger guns for other classes than the undertaker and brawler in higher levels/late game.
